concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Compatible oblique views show raised inflated sandstone probes with deep irregular lengthwise furrows and rounded pinching ends on an irregular slab. Concept centered crossings can suggest radial star; freeze three unequal overlapping probes with offset crossing and one short off-center probe, not spokes radiating from one junction. Preserve coherent host support and quiet sandstone regions. Ignore speckle/texture. Relief positive, furrows longitudinal with mild waviness, no transverse annulation or worm anatomy.
concept.hidden_surface_decisions: Each probe is a full closed corrugated cylinder embedded in the slab, with one supported overlap above the lower probe. Ends taper down into host; rear and underside remain full-volume closed original geometry. No named producer, feeding certainty or specimen-copy interpretation. Extra gray top view will verify raised longitudinal relief.
